concept.title: About
concept.shortdesc: is a cloud-based shelter management platform from . It tracks every animal from intake to adoption, so your team spends less time on paperwork and more time with the dogs.

conbody.p: Shelters of every size use , from foster-based rescues with a handful of volunteers to municipal shelters with hundreds of kennels. Everything runs in the browser at . You don't install or update anything, and new features arrive automatically. This guide covers release .

ul.li: Track animals. Keep one record per animal, with photos, kennel location, behavior notes and a full history.
Manage medical care. Log vaccinations and treatments, and see what's due today across the whole shelter.
Run adoptions. Take applications online, review them as a team, and finalize adoptions with digital contracts.
Coordinate volunteers. Publish shifts, let volunteers sign up, and track hours.
Connect other systems. Use the REST API to sync adoptable animals to your website or pull data into your own reports. See the .

section.title: Web and mobile
section.p: Staff and volunteers can also use the app for iOS and Android. It's designed for the kennel floor: scan an animal's collar tag, take photos, and log feedings or medication without going back to a desk. The app works offline and syncs when it reconnects.

section.title: For administrators
section.p: As a shelter administrator, you also manage user accounts, shelter-wide settings, reporting and your subscription. Those topics are under Administration in this guide.
